# Hash-pinned zizmor install for both halves of the split workflow,
# .github/workflows/actionlint.yml and actionlint-pr.yml (issue 1090):
#   pip install --require-hashes -r .github/requirements-zizmor.txt
#
# zizmor==1.30.1 has no transitive dependencies on PyPI, so the file is the
# one pin. Every artifact pip could resolve for it (each published wheel
# plus the sdist) carries its sha256, so the install works on any platform
# pip could run the wheel for and still fails closed on an unexpected file.
# What fails closed means here: the gate rejects downloaded content that
# matches no allowed hash, not a typo'd hash of a real artifact — pip
# pre-filters candidates by the index's #sha256= fragment, so a corrupted
# allowed-hash entry narrows the candidate set instead of failing the install.
#
# Regenerate by hand when bumping zizmor (pip-tools):
#   pip install pip-tools
#   printf 'zizmor==1.30.1\n' > requirements.in
#   pip-compile --generate-hashes --no-header --output-file=- requirements.in
# then join each pin's continuation lines onto one line, as committed here.
zizmor==1.30.1 --hash=sha256:061600f23c46f2e400bcdef666c236de7e5c0b07dd6ca046daa001eb1514b909 --hash=sha256:0fb85948ba5ffc7a8116eee36fe9cfc10167225c97bd2810e3378e66a9fd27c4 --hash=sha256:332546480be38aca95c149f835e0dcb7679ab5d74618a90c6ccb3fa6b8c7b99d --hash=sha256:587b99c2e1b34575c6c8565c2bfde415ca8bc0310f5589f19bc948c8dea10a20 --hash=sha256:5aafe617d7b1e0c0c15d58fdf20495f360f74a791dfa136f76630b4cc06c2a34 --hash=sha256:60e34e83c67064e0036989c7c525d13413e897aa4c4f683f1efb2048cdb28a47 --hash=sha256:67644ae8d6d0394204b9a488f7d86f0dd66fe562f4ba85fc53e6105a6bfc7b6a --hash=sha256:81e4093fed5c8a41d6ae7bb773085a9d2e6c0b0a0b560d46a9c76d69be0a07ed --hash=sha256:8c759e68cd866375030ca39e19e2de47a056b7be7288c1620e2d5b4c274f631f --hash=sha256:a7462b9ab45d72a20ad5ab8193b430df8184c59e2bf46954ddd09496f2f00b45 --hash=sha256:ea72f84d610643d57f96430c655a3780d0b874e477d32e14eae8e910f6cce1fd
